status: Feasibility gate passed; ready to train
hypothesis: Full temporal adaptation may learn character identity and user conditioning better than last4blocks. Short gradient windows make this fit8GBwhile preserving complete forward attention context.

training.update_policy: Accumulate all window gradients, one clipped AdamW update per full episode; weights fixed throughout episode
training.gradient_limitation: Past window attention state detached. Forward loss uses complete history but gradients intentionally truncate cross-window credit.
training.optimizer_memory: Save complete optimizer state after each update, release it for gradient computation, restore it before next update. Exact two-step AdamW parity passed.

validation: Original full-episode joint loss, paddingweight.5; same two validation episodes; candidate selected at20step intervals
audit: Same six native probes and unprompted decoded-audio ASR; raw character/overlap review required. Lower loss alone cannot pass.
data: Same57train/2validreviewedepisodes. No rejected teacher data added.
comparison: All-temporal LoRA with truncated BPTT and exact optimizer disk offload. No claim of exact full-sequence gradients.
